name: Zen Browser Sync
description: Creates an "Ambxst" mod in Zen Browser and keeps it in your Ambxst colours on every theme change, including in Zen windows already open. Can also colour web pages: selection, scrollbars and form controls everywhere, plus YouTube, GitHub, Wikipedia, Twitch and DuckDuckGo, each switchable in the Zen mod's settings.
author: Ecta250
permissions: Adds an "Ambxst" mod to the Zen profiles it finds (zen-themes.json, chrome/zen-themes/ambxst/chrome.css, chrome/zen-themes.css) and writes chrome/ambxst-web.css and chrome/ambxst-sites.css for web pages, on every theme change
With live apply on and without the optional Zen watcher, briefly opens and closes a Zen window, then gives focus back to the previous window
payload/zen/install.sh, only if you run it (with sudo for a system install), adds a startup script to the Zen install folder that reloads the mod and applies those two files to web pages
